data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was $165.426m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows net adverse prior-year development of $13.5m (8.16% of opening reserves), driven principally by deterioration in the 2014 underwriting year largely attributed to a SpaceX satellite loss and an Energy account large loss, partially offset by small favourable developments on older years. The accounts also note a net prior-year release at the net level of $3.362m, reflecting reinsurance and recoveries; the gross movement derived from the claims development table is adverse.
raw_causal_phrases: higher than normal frequency of catastrophe events in the United States ("US").
Loss experience has been noteworthy on Property Treaty, Property Direct & Facultative and Property Binding Authority.
Loss activity reflects Hurricane Matthew, an increase in US designated catastrophes, notably in respect of flood and hail losses, and the SpaceX satellite.
There were two other notable risk losses on the Energy account and the SpaceX satellite loss on the Specie & Cargo account.
Included within net claims incurred of $142,768,000 (2015: $104,327,000) is a release of $3,362,000 from claims reserves established at the prior year (2015: release $1,923,000).

data.data_quality_notes: All amounts are reported in the syndicate's presentation currency (USD). Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the balance sheet (prior-year comparative). Prior-year development (+13.5m USD) was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross values) by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2015,2016) and comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal; triangle used as primary source because the technical provision reconciliation 'movement in provision' includes current-year activity and the P&L note cites only a NET prior-year release ($3.362m). Named event years are inferred from narrative; some event-year attributions (e.g. SpaceX satellite) are ambiguous in the text. Field names contain '_gbp_m' per template but amounts are in USD (native currency).
